title: upstream.json: where an app comes from and under what licence

repo.description: Upstream repository URL, or 'private:<name>' for a private source

commit.description: Full 40-character sha for third-party sources; a short sha is accepted only for our own apps copied from Touchstone

ref.description: Branch or tag the commit was taken from (informational)

licence.description: SPDX identifier, or 'proprietary-ours' for our own code that is not yet open

licence_file.description: Path of the LICENSE file that was read, relative to the upstream root

use.description: adopt: vendored and redistributed; mutate: pinned upstream plus our published patches; run-only: fetched at setup, never redistributed; private-pull: our own private source, pulled at setup until it is opened (BD2)

vendored_at.description: Folder holding vendored code (adopt only), relative to the app folder
